description: This Java class 'ChartScrollControl' provides a GUI component for navigating through charts in a repository, with buttons and keyboard shortcuts for paging.

classes.name: ChartScrollControl
classes.description: A GUI component for scrolling through charts with buttons and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: ChartScrollControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control with a listener and setting up UI components.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Navigate to the previous chart, wrapping to the last if at the beginning.

methods.name: showChart
methods.description: Display the current chart and update info text.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Navigate to the next chart if available.

methods.name: bindKeyStrokeActions
methods.description: Bind keyboard shortcuts for navigating pages.

methods.name: setInfoText
methods.description: Update the label with current index and total size.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reset the index to zero and update display.
